messages:
alex: Quick heads-up: fresh Expo app can't bundle our JS SDK. Metro fails resolving 'stream' when importing dist/index.mjs (ESM-only package).
marie: Managed or bare workflow? Metro + ESM has quirks.
sam: Managed (Expo Go, SDK 48). Tried extraNodeModules shims for stream/crypto but hit size + runtime errors.
alex: Example error: "Unable to resolve module 'stream' from .../node_modules/redwood-sdk/dist/index.mjs". We shipped modern ESM and Metro doesn't like conditional exports.
jess: Options: publish a CJS fallback and a react-native-specific entry; or ship a tiny rn shim package that exposes minimal stream/crypto shims.
marie: Also check package.json "exports" and add "main" (cjs) plus "module" (esm). Metro often ignores exports conditions.
sam: I hacked a local fix with rn-nodeify style shims and metro.config.js pointing stream->stream-browserify, crypto->react-native-crypto, but it's fragile for customers.
alex: TS issues too: our types reference Node ReadableStream/Buffer and RN projects error with "Cannot find name 'ReadableStream'".
jess: We could publish a small dist/rn build and set package.json "react-native" field to point at it. That lets Metro prefer the RN entry without breaking web/node consumers.
marie: Yes. The RN build should avoid Node stream APIs, use lightweight async iterators for token streaming, and runtime-detect crypto.
sam: For RNG, Hermes doesn't expose crypto.getRandomValues consistently. Fallback to expo-random or react-native-get-random-values at startup: `if (!globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues) require('react-native-get-random-values')`.
alex: For typings, two approaches: 1) ship RN-friendly declaration file (ambient types) or 2) document TS config for RN apps (add lib: ["dom", "es2020"] or include a small typings shim). Publishing a separate types package is messy.
jess: I'll draft RFC to add: react-native entry, small shim bundle, TS guidance, and a sample Expo quickstart app. Also CI job to build the Expo sample to catch regressions.
marie: Add docs checklist: package.json fields (react-native/main/module), recommended polyfills, example metro.config snippet, and known caveats between Expo Go and custom dev clients.
sam: I'll prototype a Rollup target that outputs dist/rn/index.js replacing Node streams with simple async iterable helpers.
dev-bot: Reminder: RFC #248 (sdk-rn-entrypoints) assigned to @jess, due in 5 days.
alex: I'll attach a tiny repro repo (private) and link it in the ticket after I push the sample. Thanks all.
